description.narrative: FINANCE THE FOLLOWING COMPONENTS: RATIONALIZE THE ORGANIZATION AND ADMINISTRATION OF VARIOUS INSTITUTIONS FOR THE ADMINISTRATION OF JUSTICE; IMPROVE AND DEVELOP THE EXISTING INFORMATION SYSTEM; IMPROVE THE PENAL SYSTEM AND, IN THE CASE OF MINORS, ORIENT THE SYSTEM TO THEIR PROTECTION AND REINSERTION INTO SOCIETY; REDUCE JUDICIAL CONGESTION; AND SUPPORT FOR THE EXECUTION OF THE PROGRAM.
